desc: Compact yet powerful, the Everyday Fanny Pack 2.1 is the ultimate CCW-ready pack, designed with insights from Lena Miculek. It maintains all the features that made it a top seller for two years and now includes enhancements to improve your experience. The micro rapid access pull and the included holster retention accessory ensure you're ready for action as soon as it arrives. With a new exterior fabric offering sleek style and excellent water resistance, along with a secure buckle system to keep essentials in place as you navigate any terrain, this pack is built for those who never settle.
